packageRules.description: Group Tauri crates and npm packages so they update together

Platform crates that must stay on the versions Tauri's own (wry/tao) use: they share window and webview handles with Tauri, and gtk/webkit2gtk link the same system library. Update them by hand when Tauri moves (see AGENTS.md).
